items.mainDefect: Closing the backup-codes step with Escape or an outside click skips onEnable, so the UI shows 2FA as disabled even though it is enabled on the server.

secondary.defect: The modal state (step, password, codes) is not reset when it is dismissed, so reopening it shows the old backup-code screen.

items.mainDefect: Backup codes are compared with an early-exit indexOf instead of a constant-time comparison, so the timing can leak information about the stored codes.

secondary.defect: The backup-code input is not lowercased before matching, so codes typed in uppercase do not match the stored lowercase hex codes.

items.mainDefect: The copy-backup-codes e2e test only waits for the success toast and never checks what was copied, so it passes even if the copied text is wrong or empty.

secondary.defect: The download e2e test only checks the filename and never checks that the file contains the correct backup codes.
